description:
Learn how your mind works with short courses on anxiety, stress, sleep, and more. Practice CBT tools, journal your thoughts, and notice your patterns over time.

Happy turns mental-health learning into a calm, playful daily practice.

LEARN THROUGH GUIDED COURSES
• Follow bite-sized lessons about thoughts, emotions, anxiety, stress, sleep, and mental wellness.
• Learn practical ideas through interactive explanations, questions, and checkpoints.
• Move through structured journeys at your own pace.

PRACTICE CBT SKILLS
• Work through worry and overthinking with thought reframing, breathing, grounding, and guided exercises.
• Choose a structured tool when you want help with a difficult moment.
• Practice skills instead of only recording how you feel.

REFLECT YOUR WAY
• Write a journal entry, record a voice reflection, or scan a handwritten note.
• Capture your thoughts without starting from a blank page.
• Return to exercises and reflections whenever you need them.

NOTICE YOUR PATTERNS
• Review daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly views of your reflections.
• Connect moods, habits, sleep, and practice over time.
• Learn what situations and routines are connected to your experience.

BUILD A GENTLE PRACTICE
• Follow your journey, track progress, and celebrate small steps.
• Use Happy at your own pace, without pressure to be perfect.

Happy is an educational wellness and self-help tool. It does not diagnose, treat, cure, or replace professional care.
